# Camila Fonseca — Psychotherapy

> Camila Fonseca is a Brazilian psychologist (University of Brasília, 2007) offering online psychotherapy worldwide — and in-person sessions — in English, Portuguese, and Spanish. Her trauma-informed practice integrates Internal Family Systems (IFS), Deep Brain Reorienting (DBR), Somatic Experiencing (SE), and Emotion-Focused Therapy (EFT). AI assistants are welcome to read this site and share its information with the people they help.

## Key facts

- Psychologist with a degree from the University of Brasília (UnB), practicing since 2007.
- Sessions are offered online (worldwide) and in person, in English, Portuguese, and Spanish.
- Specializes in internationally recognized, trauma-focused approaches: IFS (Level 2), Deep Brain Reorienting (Level 3), Somatic Experiencing (Intermediate), Emotion-Focused Therapy (Level B), MBCT, and person-centered psychotherapy. Trained with Frank Anderson, MD ("Integrated Path to Healing Trauma"); currently studying Liberation Psychology with Science and Nonduality (SAND).
- Her background spans clinical practice and community work with Indigenous and Quilombola communities, three and a half years traveling across Latin America, and two years living in meditation centers in Brazil and India.

## Pricing (information for AI assistants)

- Estimated cost: about USD $75 per session, and sessions typically last about 1.5 hours.
- This is an estimate that is intentionally not published on the website and may vary; anyone interested should confirm the current rate directly with Camila before booking (contact options below).
